headline: How an HVAC Company Grew to ~14 Google Ads Leads a Month in Two Quarters
summary_line: PPC Guru launched EcoCare Home Comfort on Google Ads with call and form tracking wired in from day one, then grew it from about 10 genuine leads a month in its first full quarter to roughly 14 a month in the most recent quarter (Apr–Jun 2026) — a 35% quarter-over-quarter increase, with about seven in ten leads arriving as direct phone calls.
client_context: EcoCare Home Comfort is a home-comfort and HVAC company serving homeowners across Ontario, Canada. The business installs and services heating, cooling and air-conditioning systems, and its growth depends on a steady flow of homeowner enquiries — phone calls and quote requests from people who need a repair, a replacement or a new system installed. Google Ads is the company's channel for reaching those high-intent searchers at the exact moment they are looking for help, which makes reliable call and form tracking central to the account.
background: EcoCare Home Comfort brought its home-comfort advertising to PPC Guru in late 2025 for a fresh, measurement-first Google Ads build. Rather than chase clicks, the goal was a lead engine the business could trust — one where every phone call and quote request is tracked, so budget could be scaled on proven demand rather than guesswork.
analysis: Before spending began, PPC Guru set up the measurement first: call tracking on ads and the website, a lead-form conversion, and an offline import path for booked jobs. A Performance Max campaign was then launched to reach homeowners across Search, Maps and Google's wider inventory, with automated bidding pointed at genuine leads rather than surface-level clicks.
analysis_points: Build call tracking for both ad calls and website calls to the toll-free line.
Add a lead-form conversion for online quote requests.
Configure an offline import path so booked and completed jobs can be fed back to Google.
Launch a Performance Max campaign with Maximize Conversions bidding aimed at genuine phone and form leads.

timeline.what: PPC Guru launch — account built with call and form tracking, first budget live as the campaign ramped.
First full month delivered about 19 genuine leads, almost all direct phone calls.
Account settled into its first complete quarter at about 10 genuine leads a month while targeting was refined.
About 14 genuine leads a month — a 35% increase over the prior quarter — as budget was scaled into peak cooling season.

challenge: As a fresh Google Ads build, the account had to prove the channel from a standing start — establishing trustworthy tracking, learning which homeowner searches turn into booked work, and building enough conversion volume for automated bidding to optimize against. HVAC demand is also seasonal and phone-heavy, so measuring calls accurately was essential before any budget could be scaled with confidence.

changes.why: Reached homeowners across Search, Maps and Google's wider inventory from a single, conversion-focused campaign.
Captured both ad-call and website-call leads to the toll-free line — the primary way homeowners get in touch.
Tracked online quote requests so form enquiries counted alongside calls.
Set up so booked and completed jobs can be fed back to Google, pointing bidding toward real work rather than surface actions.
Let automated bidding chase genuine phone and form leads once enough conversion data existed.
As genuine leads proved out, monthly budget was increased ahead of the peak cooling months.

benchmark: Cost per lead sat near $90 in Q2 2026 as budget was scaled about 1.9x into peak cooling season, while genuine leads grew about 35% quarter over quarter. For HVAC — where a single install can be worth thousands — the account is being grown on measurable phone and form demand rather than clicks.
gradual: The account did not spike once and fade. After a strong first full month (about 19 leads in December 2025, almost all phone calls), it settled through Q1 2026 into roughly 10 genuine leads a month while targeting and negative keywords were refined. As homeowner demand picked up into spring and budget was scaled, Q2 2026 climbed to about 14 genuine leads a month. The monthly trend below shows the natural month-to-month variation of a real, seasonal HVAC account rather than a manufactured straight line.

spotlight.title: Why Call Tracking Comes First in HVAC
spotlight.body: Homeowners with a broken furnace or air conditioner call — they rarely fill in a form and wait. That is why the account was built around call tracking from day one, capturing both clicks-to-call on ads and calls placed from the website's toll-free line. About seven in ten genuine leads in the most recent quarter arrived by phone. Tracking those calls as conversions — rather than counting button clicks or map views — is what lets automated bidding find more of the searches that turn into booked service calls, and gives the business an honest line of sight from ad spend to real enquiries.

lessons: Track phone calls as conversions — in home services, the phone is the primary lead, not the form.
Set up tracking before you scale spend, so growth is based on real enquiries.
Give a new account a full quarter to gather data before judging automated bidding.
Plan budget around season — HVAC demand swings, so scale into the peaks.
Feed booked and completed jobs back to Google so bidding optimizes toward real work.
why_it_worked: Call and form tracking was built in from launch, so every genuine enquiry was measured.
Performance Max reached homeowners across Search, Maps and beyond from one focused campaign.
Budget was scaled only after leads proved out, into the peak cooling season.
The account leaned into phone calls — the highest-intent enquiry type for HVAC.
outcome: In just two full quarters under management, EcoCare Home Comfort has a working, measurable Google Ads lead engine. The most recent complete quarter (April–June 2026) generated about 14 genuine phone and form leads a month — a 35% increase over the prior quarter — with roughly seven in ten arriving as direct phone calls. Because calls and forms are tracked from the click, the business can see which spend produces real enquiries and has a clear, data-backed basis to keep scaling through the seasons.

'Now' is the most recent complete quarter (April–June 2026); the first complete quarter (January–March 2026) is the baseline. July 2026 is a partial quarter and is excluded.
